thread.title: Western Michigan University graduate applies teaching skills to mortgage industry career
thread.title_full: Western Michigan University graduate applies teaching skills to mortgage industry career

author: Great Lakes Wire
title: Western Michigan University graduate applies teaching skills to mortgage industry career
text:
Western Michigan University alumnus Jonny Shatter, who graduated in 2020, said on Apr. 15 that his education degree has helped him succeed in a new career as an executive loan officer for Zoom Home Lending. Shatter said the skills he learned at Western Michigan University (WMU) prepared him for both teaching and working in the mortgage industry.
Shatter explained that while he originally intended to become a teacher, the COVID-19 pandemic led him to reconsider his career path. He said, “I’ve always been interested in helping people understand things and improve their situations. Teaching felt like the most direct way to make an impact on people’s lives.”
He credited WMU’s programs and resources for helping students develop practical skills: “Between the on-campus programs and resources and the off-campus internships and opportunities, you’re constantly being put in positions to grow,” Shatter said. He also participated in WMU Signature, a program designed to help students complete integrative learning projects that build communication, critical thinking, and leadership abilities.
After graduation during a period of job uncertainty, Shatter decided to pursue work outside of traditional education but found many of his teaching skills useful as a mortgage broker. “Communication is probably the biggest one,” he said. “Being able to break down complex topics in a way that people understand. Also, patience, adaptability and emotional awareness.”
Alan Turfe, chairman of Zoom Home Lending and chair of the WMU Board of Trustees, praised Shatter’s contributions: “Jonathan is one of our standout bankers not only because of his skill in helping our customers but because of his character and work ethic.” Turfe added that Shatter’s journey reflects “the entrepreneurial spirit, initiative and adaptability that Western instills.” According to Turfe, Zoom Home Lending is among the top five U.S. mortgage brokers.
Western Michigan University fields 16 Division I varsity sports as a Mid-American Conference member according to its official website . The university enrolls more than 17,000 students according to its official website and supports inclusive excellence for all students according to its official website . WMU emphasizes education that is learner-focused, research-oriented and globally involved according to its official website , promotes sustainability with LEED-certified buildings according to its official website , and has earned top-100 rankings for several graduate programs nationally according to its official website .
Looking ahead, Shatter hopes his story will inspire other WMU students or alumni considering nontraditional paths after graduation. “The journey doesn’t have to look exactly how you planned it,” he said.
